extensionDescription.message: Optional page-level media targets for the Media Lock desktop application.

popupDescription.message: Authorize one unambiguous media element on the active HTTPS page. Media Lock must already be running.

statusAuthorized.message: Authorized. Select this page in Media Lock to create Session Lock.

statusNotAuthorized.message: Not authorized. Authorize this page to create Session Lock.

statusSiteAllowedWaiting.message: This site is allowed. Waiting for one unambiguous media element.

statusReopen.message: Reopen the extension before requesting site access.

statusRequestingSite.message: Requesting access to this exact site…

statusAuthorizingSite.message: Authorizing one media element for this site…

statusAuthorizingTemporary.message: Authorizing one media element on this page…

errorPageNotEligible.message: This page cannot be authorized. Open an HTTPS page with one media element. (ML-BR-001)

errorExtensionConnectionFailed.message: The Extension could not check this page. Reload the Extension and page, then try again. (ML-BR-002)

errorTargetUnavailable.message: The selected media page is no longer available. Reload the page and try again. (ML-BR-003)

errorPermissionDenied.message: Site access was not granted. Review the browser site permission and try again. (ML-BR-004)

errorNativeHostUnavailable.message: Media Lock is not available. Start Media Lock and try again. (ML-BR-005)

errorAmbiguousMediaElements.message: More than one media element is available. Leave only one active media element and try again. (ML-BR-006)

errorMediaElementUnavailable.message: No controllable media element is available on this page. (ML-BR-007)

errorDocumentReplaced.message: The page changed during authorization. Wait for it to finish loading and try again. (ML-BR-008)

errorUnauthorizedCommand.message: The authorization request is no longer valid. Reopen the Popup and try again. (ML-BR-009)

errorPlayRejected.message: The page rejected playback. Start playback on the page and try again. (ML-BR-010)

errorSeekOutOfRange.message: The requested position is outside the media timeline. (ML-BR-011)

errorUnknown.message: An unexpected Browser Integration error occurred. Try again. (ML-BR-000)
